title: Add a number of months to a date, clamping to the month's last day
levels: Meets every requirement in the brief
Misses at least one requirement in the brief

cases.rationale: A floored month index and calendar.monthrange give the right clamped date in both directions, and the type and range errors match the brief.
It treats every year divisible by 4 as a leap year, so add_months(date(2100, 1, 31), 1) raises ValueError instead of returning date(2100, 2, 28).

It accepts a datetime.datetime and returns a datetime, and accepts True as a month count, where the brief requires TypeError, while the note claiming those rules were dropped is not part of the brief.
Exact type tests reject bool and datetime, the full Gregorian leap rule sets February's length, and floor arithmetic carries negative moves across years.
